record.dic_text:
03756 Karmiy {kar-mee'}

源自 03754; 陽性專有名詞 人名

AV - Carmi 8; 8

迦米 = "我的葡萄園"
1) 流便的第四個兒子, 且是迦米族的祖先
2) 猶大人, 亞干的父親
record.edic_text:
03756 Karmiy {kar-mee'}

from 03754;; n pr m

AV - Carmi 8; 8

Carmi = "my vineyard"
1) the 4th son of Reuben and progenitor of the Carmites
2) a Judaite, father of Achan, the 'troubler of Israel' in the time
   of Joshua
